# AMN Healthcare

> AMN Healthcare is a comprehensive healthcare staffing and talent solutions platform offering travel nursing, locum tenens, and permanent placement services across multiple clinical disciplines.

AMN Healthcare connects healthcare professionals with job opportunities across nursing, allied health, physician, advanced practice, dentistry, and leadership roles. The platform serves candidates nationwide with resources including career blogs, application portals, and the AMN Passport App for streamlined job searching and management.

## Key Topics

- Healthcare staffing
- Travel nursing
- Locum tenens
- Permanent positions
- Nursing careers
- Physician Assistant
- Nurse Practitioner

- Job search

## Career Opportunities

- [Travel, Per Diem, and Crisis Nursing Jobs](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/careers/nursing): Nursing job search and career opportunities via AMN Healthcare.
- [Allied Healthcare Jobs](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/careers/allied): Allied healthcare career opportunities including imaging and therapy.
- [Physician Jobs: Locum Tenens and Perm](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/careers/physician): Physician locum tenens and permanent position opportunities.
- [Advanced Practice Provider Jobs](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/careers/advanced-practice): NP, PA, CRNA, and telemedicine placement services and positions.
- [Dentist Jobs: Locum and Permanent Positions](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/careers/dentistry): Dentist and dental hygienist locum and permanent career placements.
- [Healthcare Leadership Careers](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/careers/leadership): Healthcare leadership and executive interim/permanent positions.

## Job Application & Getting Started

- [Apply For Healthcare Jobs Today](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/apply): Healthcare job application portal for travel and interim positions.
- [Healthcare Staffing Company | AMN Healthcare](https://www.amnhealthcare.com): AMN Healthcare homepage featuring staffing and talent solutions.

## Professional Resources & Blogs

- [Nursing Job Seeker Blog](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/blog/nursing): Nursing career news and resources for travel nursing professionals.
- [Allied Healthcare Blogs and latest News](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/blog/allied): Allied healthcare industry news and professional development content.
- [Physician: Locum Tenens & Permanent Blogs](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/blog/physician): Physician career news covering licensing, taxes, and employment trends.
- [Advanced Practice Job Seeker Blogs](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/blog/advanced-practice): Advanced practice career trends and employment outlook information.
- [Dentistry: Locum Tenens & Permanent Blogs](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/blog/dentist): Dental career news, licensing, and travel dentistry information.
